_schema.note: Curated to deadlines that materially affect federal-health-IT procurement. Each entry links to authoritative source plus MMT's read on capture impact.

deadlines.label: Q3 FY26 close
deadlines.headline: Mid-year obligation push window
deadlines.fy_impact: Final ~3 months to obligate remaining FY26 funds before fiscal-year close pressure
deadlines.capture_read: Agencies push to obligate remaining FY26 dollars in Q4 FY26 (Jul–Sep). Watch for accelerated task-order awards on existing IDIQs and small-dollar buys clearing in this window. Capture teams that respond fast win.

deadlines.label: FY26 fiscal year end
deadlines.headline: FY27 funding gap risk — CR or shutdown territory
deadlines.fy_impact: FY27 begins Oct 1. If appropriations don't pass, agencies operate under Continuing Resolution: capped at FY26 levels, limited new starts, restrictions on contract awards above the CR rate.
deadlines.capture_read: The biggest deadline on this calendar for federal-health-IT capture. New solicitations slow under CR. Task orders against existing IDIQs are the safest bet — they're authorized at the IDIQ level and don't require new appropriations. If your pipeline depends on FY27 new starts, build a CR scenario and a back-up TO pursuit list now.
related_expirations: New Medicaid provider tax limits take effect

deadlines.label: Calendar year end
deadlines.headline: Medicare Physician Payment increase expires
deadlines.fy_impact: Direct CMS reimbursement impact; physician practices and Medicare-touching IT vendors see margin pressure. Indirect: CMS administrative budget pressure may delay non-essential IT modernization buys.
deadlines.capture_read: Not a contract deadline directly, but if you sell to CMS or to Medicare-billing health systems, watch for downstream RFP slips. Vendors whose revenue model depends on physician-practice IT investment should expect Q1 2027 buying-cycle softness.

appropriations_status.fy26_status: Enacted — current law in effect through 2026-09-30
appropriations_status.fy27_status: Pending — FY27 budget request submitted by White House April 2026; appropriations process underway in Congress
appropriations_status.cr_history_note: Federal fiscal years frequently begin under a Continuing Resolution rather than full-year appropriations. Plan capture timelines assuming a 30–90-day CR runway in Q1 FY27.
